messages:
Maya: Quick one — my kid's school announced an unexpected winter closure 2026-12-27 to 2027-01-03 which overlaps the company year-end shutdown. Im trying to understand whether I should use PTO for additional childcare days or if there's any carryover protection for dependent-care disruptions.
Evan - People Ops: Thanks for flagging, Maya. For unplanned dependent-care closures during the company shutdown we have two paths: 1) if it's outside your scheduled workdays, usually no PTO is needed because you're already covered by the shutdown; 2) if the closure causes you to need additional days off beyond the shutdown, request PTO as usual. We can consider a one-time carryover exception if documentation shows the closure prevented you from taking scheduled PTO. :family:
Maya: The tricky part is that I had two PTO days booked 12/28-12/29 to travel, but now school closure means I need coverage 12/30-12/31 instead. Id rather not lose the travel days.
Priya (Manager): I can swap those dates around on my team schedule. If People Ops can approve a date swap or retroactive rebooking, that would be ideal.
Evan - People Ops: Policy excerpt: `One-time adjustments to PTO dates may be approved in extenuating dependent-care circumstances during shutdowns, subject to manager sign-off and evidence of disruption (school closure notice or communication).` Please upload the school closure notice to the HR portal or email people-ops@redwood.ai with subject `Dependent-care disruption - Maya`.
people-ops-bot: Ticket created: PO-8912. Attachments: none yet. Expect review in 1-2 business days.
Maya: Uploaded the school notice and added a short note about my original PTO booking.
people-ops-bot: Attachment received. Ticket PO-8912 updated.
Evan - People Ops: Got it. We'll review, confirm with Payroll, and if approved we'll either: A) move your approved PTO from 12/28-12/29 to 12/30-12/31 (manager approval required) OR B) grant a one-time carryover exception for the affected accrual year so you don't lose the days. We'll follow whichever preserves payment and team coverage best.
Priya (Manager): I approve swapping the dates on my end. Maya  go ahead and submit a PTO change request and ping me; I'll click approve.
Payroll: FYI payroll will reconcile any retroactive date changes on the next run. If a carryover exception is granted, we'll adjust your balances accordingly.
Maya: Thanks all  submitted the PTO change request and emailed people-ops. Appreciate the quick help. :heart:
